overview:
**Fire danger is Low today across the Montrose (High Elevation) area, with dry air and light winds keeping ERC near 48%.**
- Danger trends to Moderate midweek (Nov 10–11, 13–15) before easing back to Low on Nov 12, per the 7-day outlook.
- A stubborn high-pressure ridge is steering storms around Colorado, keeping skies sunny and dry with no precipitation expected this week.
- Winds stay light (5–10 mph, shifting N to NE) and no Red Flag Warning is posted; 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met today.
- Overnight lows dip near freezing (around 30°) while afternoon highs run in the upper 40s to mid-50s.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions have been lifted in the BLM Gunnison Field Office area; only standard year-round wildfire prevention rules remain in effect, and Montrose County currently has no county fire restrictions in effect.
- No active wildfires are burning in or near this area's counties; nationally, fire activity remains low at Preparedness Level 1.
